shell_integration.title: Remote Shell Integration
shell_integration.description: Install transparent shell hooks for exact working-directory awareness in SSH terminals.
shell_integration.mode_hint: Choose whether OxideTerm asks when needed, installs automatically, or skips Shell integration after a new SSH terminal opens.
shell_integration.confirm_description: OxideTerm will install readable integration files on {{host}} and add one marked reference to the detected Shell startup file. Continue?
shell_integration.confirm_description_terminal: Directory tracking is not configured on {{host}}. Install the readable Shell integration now? It will activate in newly opened SSH terminals; this terminal remains untouched.
shell_integration.disclosure: OxideTerm writes readable Bash, Zsh, Fish, Nushell, and PowerShell hooks to the directory below. The detected shell startup file receives one clearly marked reference. The hooks report the current working directory and host name through standard OSC 7. A per-channel SSH marker gates private editor messages, and known shared multiplexers suppress them; terminal output is never hidden or erased.
shell_integration.restart_hint: The change applies to newly opened SSH terminals. Existing shells are not restarted.
shell_integration.no_active_host: No host selection is required here. OxideTerm checks automatically when an SSH terminal opens; connected hosts can still be managed here manually.
shell_integration.install_complete: Remote shell integration installed. Open a new terminal to activate it.
shell_integration.reference_removed: Startup reference removed; integration files were kept.
shell_integration.all_removed: Startup reference and OxideTerm integration files removed.

ide.title: IDE Mode (Mini)
ide.description: Configure the built-in code editor behavior.
ide.external_editor_hint: Path to the external editor used to edit remote files (empty = system default)
ide.auto_save_hint: Automatically save files when switching tabs or losing focus.
ide.word_wrap_hint: Wrap long lines instead of horizontal scrolling.
ide.agent_description: OxideTerm can deploy a lightweight agent binary to remote hosts for enhanced IDE performance. The agent provides POSIX-native file operations, real-time file watching, and faster search — all running locally on the remote server.
ide.agent_feature_atomic: Atomic file writes (no data loss on network disruption)
ide.agent_feature_watch: Real-time file watching via inotify (instant refresh)
ide.agent_feature_hash: Hash-based conflict detection (prevents overwriting external changes)
ide.agent_feature_search: Server-side grep and deep directory tree loading
ide.agent_auto_hint: When opening IDE mode on supported Linux x86_64/aarch64 hosts, the agent is deployed based on the policy below — you will be prompted to confirm on first use (or deploy automatically if set to 'Always Enable').
ide.agent_extra_hint: Prebuilt binaries are no longer provided for other architectures. Build the agent from source yourself, then manually upload it to ~/.oxideterm/oxideterm-agent on the remote host.
ide.agent_path_detail: The agent binary is placed at ~/.oxideterm/oxideterm-agent in the remote user's home directory.
ide.agent_lifecycle_detail: Deployed on first IDE mode open and persists between sessions. Automatically updated when a new version is available. Can be safely deleted at any time — it will be re-deployed when needed.
ide.agent_privacy_detail: The agent is a standalone binary that communicates exclusively with OxideTerm over the existing SSH connection (stdio). It makes no third-party network connections, sends no telemetry, and collects no data.
ide.editor_typography_hint: Override terminal font size and line height for the code editor. Leave empty to follow terminal settings.

ide.line_height_hint: Editor line spacing. Empty = follow terminal.
ide.agent_mode_hint: Control whether OxideTerm deploys the agent to remote hosts when opening IDE mode.

help.title: Help & About
help.description: Application information, keyboard shortcuts, and resources.
help.debug_logs_hint: Write verbose debug-level logs after restart. Leave this off unless you are diagnosing a problem.
help.open_logs_hint: Open the application log directory in your file manager
help.legal_notice_description: This notice is bundled with the app and mirrors the repository LEGAL.md file.
help.safety_authorized: OxideTerm is intended for authorized system administration, debugging, remote operations, device access, and file transfer. Use it only on systems you own, manage, or have explicit permission to operate.
help.safety_connections: SSH, SFTP, Telnet, Serial, RDP/VNC, port forwarding, and proxy-jump features connect to targets you choose. Make sure those connections, routes, and forwarded traffic are allowed by your organization and local rules.
help.safety_prohibited: Do not use OxideTerm for unauthorized access, credential attacks, evading network restrictions, covert remote control, vulnerability exploitation, destructive activity, or data exfiltration.
help.safety_privacy: OxideTerm runs as a local client by default. It does not require an account, collect telemetry, or upload terminal content, connection profiles, command history, private keys, or credentials to an OxideTerm service.
help.safety_secrets: Credentials and API keys should stay in system secure storage where supported. Before sharing logs, screenshots, exported bundles, diagnostics, or prompts, review and redact secrets, hostnames, usernames, and internal paths.
help.safety_ai: OxideSens sends only user-selected context to the configured model endpoint. Review AI suggestions and commands before execution, and do not send private keys, passwords, production secrets, or regulated data to models.
help.license: OxideTerm is open source software licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
help.update_available_toast: A new version is available. Go to Settings → Help to update.
help.native_update_hint: Native updates use the selected manifest channel and download the package for this platform.
help.update_downloaded_hint: Downloaded to {{path}}. Open the package to finish installation, then restart OxideTerm.
help.installer_launched_hint: Follow the platform installer. OxideTerm will quit so the installer can continue safely.
help.replacement_scheduled_hint: OxideTerm will quit so the staged installer can replace this build, then it will relaunch.
help.portable_update_manual_hint: Portable updates require replacing the whole portable folder with the newer build.
help.portable_mode_hint: This session is using the portable bootstrap flow and keeps its data next to the executable.
help.portable_updates_hint: Automatic checks and in-app updates replace only application files. Portable data, plugins, the keystore, portable.json, and custom data directories are preserved.
help.update_channel_hint: Stable and Beta use separate release channels
